slice: generic channel ingress foundation: normalized identity, persistent dedup, audience and revisions
purpose: Build the generic channel ingress foundation offline: trusted adapter-derived platform/account/channel/thread/message identities, persistent intake/dedup/revision/tombstone ledgers, versioned audiences with invalidation signals, and two-stage metadata/body capture - without a real platform, account or channel.

implementation.identity: connection/conversation/participant/message identities are derived only from trusted adapter metadata at registration (namespace/platform/deployment/accountId/nativeAccountId/kind; conversation mode/thread; participant namespace+accountId+nativeParticipantId; message conversationRef); display names and body claims never participate, same short ids across accounts never merge, and same display names may coexist. Body content is strict data (contentHash/bodyRef/summary<=512B/<=8 attachment refs) and cannot add envelope fields or roles. Reusing an explicit nativeEventId across conversations yields SOURCE_EVENT_CONFLICT.
implementation.dedupAndRevisions: unique key (namespace, account, conversationRef, sourceEventId); same key+same fingerprint returns the original intakeSeq as duplicate, same key+different fingerprint is a persistent conflict rejection; native message revisions must strictly increase (stale does not overwrite); withdrawal/deletion are terminal tombstones that clear content references, keep digests/source/native revision, advance a deletion watermark and emit an invalidation signal; 100 events x 10 interleaved redeliveries = 100 facts / 900 duplicates.
implementation.audience: DM fixes a single counterpart; group/channel uses a replaceable member set with audienceVersion CAS; member removal records per-person revocation watermarks; revokeAccess(participant|conversation); onInvalidation sink plus pull-based invalidationsAfter; a sink throw rolls back the audience change/deletion in the same transaction (tested against the real ConversationStore so an old draft becomes STALE_CONTEXT).
implementation.content: captureAudience returns metadata only (no summary/bodyRef/attachment refs); readContentRefs re-checks capture expiry, current audienceVersion, per-message captured revision and terminal state before returning trusted references; cross-audience messageIds are rejected as CROSS_AUDIENCE. The control DB stores no message bodies: digest + trusted bodyRef + bounded summary only.
implementation.wiring: new contracts/channel.ts (15 channel.* IPC commands and views/watermark/invalidation types), pure control/ingress identity and validation model, a persistent IngressDomain on the same ControlStore Worker/SqliteTransactions and incremental worker/protocol dispatch (+18 lines, existing command semantics unchanged).
